notes: Strategy leads: under the summoning wrapper this is a wave-defense game — enemies spawn from one side of a pathway and march on the Camera Base while the player places and upgrades bought units, which is the Tower Defense preset. Party & Casual is genuinely second because half the prompt is a lobby: a giant building with a 100$ summoning storefront and a five-player teleporter into the match, giving social-hub and teleporter-link. Shape is lane-actor-track over space-staged — the answers call the match one small unbranched city street that five players hold together, and its P6 cannot be dropped since the enemy route must be continuous and valid; I added P4 alongside because the answers state the spawn building is a separate lobby map rather than attached to the city. Decided without a user: kept the preset whole, since a narrow city street does not contradict its pinch point, kept settlement-density for the requested tiny oversized-scale city, and treated rarities, roll odds, inventory and per-unit damage/range numbers as progression and UI rather than layout.
